identity.title: Core Alterations With Source Range Monitor Inoperable Results in Condition Prohibited by Technical Specifications

cause.proximate_text: The root cause of this event was the Refuel Senior Reactor Operator (SRO) did not recognize the plant condition change of SRM A being inoperable because the shift turnover and relief procedure did not include a step for the oncoming Refuel SRO to contact the control room for SRM status prior to commencing fuel movement for the shift.
cause.theme: Shift turnover procedure gap - inadequate SRM status verification

properties.note: SRM 'A' monitors North-West core quadrant; instrument type [RIT] per TS 3.3.1.2

nodes.display_name: Refuel SRO did not recognize SRM A inoperable status
nodes.description: Shift turnover and relief procedure lacked a step requiring the oncoming Refuel SRO to contact the control room for SRM status prior to commencing fuel movement.

nodes.display_name: Fuel bundle placed in monitored quadrant with SRM inoperable
nodes.description: Fuel bundle placed at position 07-44 in the North-West quadrant while SRM 'A' was inoperable, contrary to TS 3.3.1.2; a second bundle move at 21-36 was also in progress at time of discovery.

nodes.display_name: Core alterations performed in condition prohibited by Technical Specifications
